chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Sa'd ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Hamzah al-Ash'ari, who said: Yasir the servant told me that he heard Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) say:

Indeed, the most horrible for this creation is in three instances: the day he is born and leaves his mother's womb and sees this world; the day he dies and sees the Hereafter and its people; and the day he is resurrected and sees judgments which he has not seen in the abode of this world.

And the Honorable, the Exalted God sent peace on John in these three instances and calmed his fear, saying: 'And peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!'

And Jesus the son of Mary (peace be upon him) sent peace on himself in these three instances and said: 'So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)!'
ai.seo_question: What are the three most terrifying moments for humans according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) identifies birth, death, and resurrection as the three most awe-inspiring moments for humanity, supported by the Quranic salutations upon Prophet John and Prophet Jesus during these exact transitions. This narration, found in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, highlights the theological significance of these milestones as times of profound spiritual reckoning, where divine peace serves to reassure the soul amidst the overwhelming reality of the unseen.
